name: Free Education For Sports Medal Winners / Participants Of National/ International Events

items.text: The scheme "Free Education for Sports Medal Winners / Participants of National/ International Events", introduced by the University Grants Commission, Ministry of Education, aims to assist medal-winning sportspersons pursuing higher education and motivate them to achieve excellence in sports and academics. Applicable to national medalists and international participants, it ensures their holistic development.

items.heading: Participation at SAF Games; Medal at National level Competitions

items.text: (i) The Scholarship will be provided to the Medal winners of National games and participants in recognized international sporting events recognized by the World University Service, International Olympic Committee, and Olympic Committee of Asia (OCA) who have taken admitted to the Universities/Colleges/Institutions as indicated below:
Universities/Institutions/Colleges included under sections 2(f) and 12(b) of the UGC Act, 1956.
Deemed to be Universities under section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956 which are eligible to receive grants
in aid from UGC.
Universities/Institutions/Colleges funded by Central/ State Govt.
Institutes of National Importance.
(ii) In the subsequent years this scholarship shall depend on their subsequent sports performance.
CANCELLATION OF SCHOLARSHIP
items.heading: CANCELLATION OF SCHOLARSHIP

items.text: UGC may terminate the scholarship of any student in the case of the:
items.heading: CANCELLATION OF SCHOLARSHIP

items.text: (i) Misconduct of the candidate, if any, reported by the University/College/Institution.
items.heading: CANCELLATION OF SCHOLARSHIP

items.text: (ii) Unsatisfactory progress report i.e. if the candidate frequently fails in his/her examination will not be given further assistance.
items.heading: CANCELLATION OF SCHOLARSHIP

items.text: (iii) The scholarship may be terminated by the Commission, on the recommendation of the University at
items.heading: CANCELLATION OF SCHOLARSHIP

items.text: anytime during the tenure and the decision of the Commission will be final and binding.
items.heading: CANCELLATION OF SCHOLARSHIP

items.text: Step 1: Download the prescribed application form (Refer Page No. 5 ).
Step 2: Fill in the application form with accurate details.
Step 3: Attach a certificate of participation or medal-winning as proof of eligibility, attested by the Registrar or Principal of your institution.
Step 4: Verify the form and attached documents for completeness and accuracy.
Step 5: Submit the completed application form and required documents to the designated authority.
To Be Submitted by the Candidate through University/College -
items.heading: To Be Submitted by the Candidate through University/College -

items.text: 1. The candidate is required to submit an application in the prescribed format for availing of the scholarship.
items.heading: To Be Submitted by the Candidate through University/College -

items.text: 2. A Certificate of the participation/medal winner as per the eligibility mentioned above as proof (Attested By Registrar/Principal).
items.heading: To Be Submitted by the Candidate through University/College -

items.text: Every year University/Institution will submit a complete statement of the following:
items.heading: To Be Submitted by the concerned University/College/Institution to the UGC -

items.text: 1. Statement giving the names of the students selected for the scholarship along with their receipt of the scholarship amount.
items.heading: To Be Submitted by the concerned University/College/Institution to the UGC -

items.text: 2. Progress Report to be submitted after the completion of the first year in terms of sports performance and academics.
items.heading: To Be Submitted by the concerned University/College/Institution to the UGC -

items.text: 3. Utilization certificate for the previous grant released.
items.heading: To Be Submitted by the concerned University/College/Institution to the UGC -

items.text: 4. A certificate giving justification for the continuance of the scholarship issued by the Director/Head of the Department duly forwarded by the Registrar/Principal.
